# Cherekh Center

> Cherekh Center is a hill-stay lodging in Thanchi, Bandarban, Bangladesh. Nine guest rooms, on-site restaurant, conference space, and help arranging trekking, river, and cultural visits.

## Summary

- **Name:** Cherekh Center (also known as Cherekh Center Thanchi)
- **Type:** Hotel / lodging / boutique hill stay
- **Location:** Thanchi Upazila, Bandarban District, Chittagong Division, Bangladesh
- **Coordinates:** 21.8166336, 92.4336567
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/NsotNbMtt8tRfpkL7
- **Check-in:** 2:00 PM | **Check-out:** 11:00 AM
- **Rooms:** 9 guest rooms numbered 103-206 (double and couple beds; Non-AC and AC options)
- **Capacity:** Up to 4 guests per double-bed room (3 included); couple rooms typically 2-3
- **Conference room:** 80-100 people
- **Best for:** Couples, families, small groups, corporate retreats, nature travel

## Amenities

Free WiFi, garden and hill views, on-site restaurant, conference room, 24/7 reception, parking, room service, hot water, guided local experiences.

## Dining

Cherekh Restaurant serves authentic local tribal cuisine, traditional Bangla dishes, and international options. Complimentary breakfast is included with room stays.

## Activities nearby

Hill trekking, river activities, village and cultural visits, sunset viewpoints, camping (guided).

## Common questions

**Where to stay in Thanchi?** Cherekh Center is a lodging option in Thanchi Upazila with nine rooms, on-site dining, and direct booking at https://cherekhcenter.com/booking. Official map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/NsotNbMtt8tRfpkL7

**Where to stay in Bandarban near Thanchi?** Thanchi is an upazila of Bandarban district. Guests staying at Cherekh Center use it as a base for hill views, river access, trekking, and cultural visits.

**Family-friendly?** Yes - double-bed rooms fit up to 4 guests; children under 12 are not charged extra-guest fees.

**Conference or event venue?** Yes - dedicated conference room for 80-100 people with AV equipment and catering.
